name: chembl-mcp-server
description: Link compounds to protein targets, rank bioactivity, and look up drug mechanisms and indications.

CHEMBL_API_BASE_URL.title: ChEMBL API base URL
CHEMBL_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the ChEMBL REST data API. Override for a private mirror or pinned host.

CHEMBL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.title: Request timeout (ms)
CHEMBL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-attempt timeout in milliseconds for an upstream ChEMBL request, capped by what is left of the call's time budget (45 s for most calls, CHEMBL_SPILL_DEADLINE_MS for a bioactivity spill).

CHEMBL_MAX_PAGE_SIZE.title: Max page size
CHEMBL_MAX_PAGE_SIZE.description: Rows per upstream ChEMBL page (max 1000). The bioactivity spill walks pages of this size; an inline bioactivity page requests its limit, capped at this size.

CHEMBL_DEFAULT_LIMIT.title: Default result limit
CHEMBL_DEFAULT_LIMIT.description: Default result limit applied when callers omit it.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
